{{Infobox quest |image =AmbulancesBanner.png |icon = |given by =[[Therapist]] |location =[[Streets of Tarkov]] |LL requirement =2 |LL quests =2 |previous = |leads to = |related = }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|Young man, I have a task that suits your area of expertise. A friend of mine, a paramedic still early in his career, recently told me a disturbing story. Just before the catastrophe, he was transporting patients with unexplained symptoms, almost as if there had been an outbreak of a new disease. At the hospitals, unfamiliar individuals would take them away and transfer them to private wards. The young man managed to photograph their observation logs while they were collecting another patient. However, in the midst of the catastrophe, he dropped his smartphone containing all the data. He says they were on their way to pick up another patient near the Concordia residential complex. For everyone's sake, please find this phone for me. The paramedic will be waiting for you under the protection of my people, inside an SUV on Primorsky Avenue, and he will confirm its authenticity. I sincerely hope I can count on you, young man.}} ==Objectives== * Locate and obtain the [[Paramedic's GPhone X|ambulance paramedic's smartphone]] on [[Streets of Tarkov]] * Extract from [[Streets of Tarkov]] through Primorsky Ave Taxi V-Ex * Hand over the [[Paramedic's GPhone X|smartphone]] ==Rewards== * +10,000 [[EXP]] * [[Therapist]] Rep '''+0.25''' * 165,000 Roubles ** 173,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 189,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 {{quote|Yes, I've heard the report, this is what we've been looking for. My men will begin retrieving the information immediately. And you, young man, are free to go. Thank you for your help.}} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- |[[File:ParamedicsSmartphoneIcon.png|link=Paramedic's GPhone X]] |[[Paramedic's GPhone X]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |''This [[Quests#Quest items|quest item]] can only be found if the quest is active.''

''If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it.'' |} In this quest you have to find the [[Paramedic's GPhone X|ambulance paramedic's smartphone]] on [[Streets of Tarkov]] and extract with it through the "Primorsky Ave Taxi V-Ex" extraction while it is in your in-raid quest inventory. The taxi extraction with the phone does not need to be done in the same raid that you found the phone. The phone can be located at one of eight ambulances across the location.
